goal: Ensure Sunday/holiday Venus auto-attendance is only marked synced when Millware has corresponding regular PR_TASKREGLN data.

code_context.responsibility: Queries PR_TASKREGLN and emits per employee-date comparison results.
relevant_logic: needsRegularRecord currently based on not ALFA/N/A

code_context.responsibility: Runs /api/comparison/compare and converts result details into comparisonData map.
Renders attendance matrix comparison states and summary counts.
relevant_logic: renderWarning comparison tooltip has needsRegular excluding OFF
getSyncStatus requires hasRegularRecord for non ALFA/N/A
summary counts call getSyncStatus for presence and OT

code_context.responsibility: Builds Venus attendance day records and auto-attendance statuses for Sunday/holiday.
relevant_logic: Sunday missing Venus record is displayed as OFF with regularHours = 7
Holiday missing Venus record is displayed as LBR with regularHours based on day type

known_example.expected_when_millware_missing: status MISS / syncStatus mismatch or not_synced; UI red not synced

testing_notes: Backend has node:test style tests in backend/services/*.test.js. Frontend has utility tests and build script, but AttendanceMatrix appears not covered by unit tests. Prefer adding a small pure helper export if feasible, otherwise add focused backend regression and build verification.
